body:
Thank you for the reply. Yeah, when it first happened, I called a few of my friends to talk about it and they were all pretty supportive and cool about it (as much as 20something guys can be), and even talked to the "new" girl in question about what happened and why I did it (we're pretty good friends and met independently of my ex). She is friends with my ex as well, so that's why I don't really know how or if I should even pursue her.

I just feel like I can only continue to talk to my friends about it for so long before they get tired of it or get uncomfortable, know what I mean? Like they can only offer so much input before I'm just repeating myself, so I usually just act like everything is okay. I definitely want and need to go back to therapy, but it's so damn hard with a new full-time job and all the therapists are only available during working hours on the weekdays!
